identity_rule: A published hard-bank version is one file whose bytes never change; a correction ships as a new file with a new version and a new sha16. This registry is the ONLY place a bank file name may be mapped to a version label: `bank-hard-v6.json` holds v6.1 bytes (it was edited in place before this rule existed - the identity trap that made pre-fix workspace bank copies silently possible), and it stays labelled v6.1 here forever. scripts/build_hard_v6_ws.py fails closed if a bank file does not appear in this registry with matching bytes, and stamps the resolved version into every generated workspace as `bank-version.json`, which `gate_run` writes into the run record.
sha_rule: sha16 = sha256 of the file bytes, first 16 hex characters
